# semaphore_ex_user_api_token (Data Source)

Reads non-secret metadata for an API token owned by the configured Semaphore EX user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_user_api_token" "automation" {
  token_id = semaphore_ex_user_api_token.automation.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `token_id` (String) Stable, non-secret API token identifier to read.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation time reported by Semaphore EX.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether Semaphore EX reports the token as expired.
- `expires_at` (String) Token expiry time, when configured.
- `id` (String) Stable, non-secret API token identifier.
- `name` (String) Human-readable API token name.
- `user_id` (Number) Owner user ID reported by Semaphore EX.
